verdict.rationale: The product is a skill pack distributed through an installer CLI (`npx skills`) and agent plugin marketplaces, so telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any way to disable them. The documented controls cover update behavior only (e.g. 'Nothing updates behind your back', plugins that 'update itself by default'), not data collection.
